claim: The 11 DOCG villages allowed to label their wine Barolo are Barolo, Castiglione Falletto, Serralunga d'Alba, Cherasco, Diano d'Alba, Grinzane Cavour, La Morra, Monforte d'Alba, Novello, Roddi and Verduno, and Barolo village has ~23 wine cellars and 7 shops open to the public.
quote: The 11 town and villages which are DOCG certified and which are allowed to label their wine Barolo are: Barolo, Castiglione Falletto, Serralunga d'Alba, Cherasco, Diano d'Alba, Grinzane Cavour, La Morra, Monforte d'Alba, Novello, Roddi and Verduno.

claim: Key Langhe villages include Barbaresco (12th-century tower, 360-degree panorama, Enoteca Regionale in a deconsecrated church), Barolo (Falletti Castle and WiMu wine museum), La Morra (Balcony of the Langhe with the Barolo Chapel), Neive (one of Italy's most beautiful villages), and Serralunga d'Alba (14th-century French-style donjon castle).
quote: Barbaresco - Known for its iconic 12th-century tower offering 360-degree panorama views... La Morra - Nicknamed the Balcony of the Langhe... Neive - Ranked among Italy's most beautiful villages... Serralunga d'Alba - Features an unmistakable 14th-century castle built as a unique Italian example of a French donjon.

claim: Grinzane Cavour Castle costs EUR 8 full / EUR 3 children, opens 10:00-19:00 April-October (10:00-18:00 in winter, closed Tuesdays), houses the Langhe Museum and Enoteca Regionale Piemontese Cavour, and exterior viewing is free.
quote: Full price: EUR 8,00 ... Reduced: EUR 6,00 ... Children 6-14: EUR 3,00 ... Peak Season (April-October): Open from 10.00 to 7.00 Last admission at 6.00

claim: Average price of a winery visit with tasting in Barolo is around EUR 35 (range EUR 15-55), and spring offers good weather with fewer crowds while September-October brings harvest and truffle festivals.
quote: The average price of a wine tasting with winery visit in Barolo is around EUR 35, with prices ranging from EUR 15 to EUR 55.

claim: Marchesi di Barolo, founded in 1806 in Barolo village, offers cellar tours with tastings or a full menu of typical Piedmontese dishes, and is among the historic producers alongside Ceretto, Vietti, Conterno, Bruno Giacosa, Pio Cesare and Damilano.
quote: You can book a visit to the cellars of the Marchesi di Barolo with a tasting or a complete menu of typical Piedmontese dishes.

claim: In Barbaresco the average price of a cellar tour with wine tasting is about EUR 54, with top-rated wineries for visitors including Tenuta Baràc, Agricola Gian Piero Marrone and Tenuta Carretta (all averaging 4.8 stars).
quote: In Barbaresco, the average price of a cellar tour with wine tasting is EUR 54.00.
